title: Listening and questioning
learning_outcomes: Explain reflective listening in the context of listening and questioning.
Compare and distinguish question types in the context of listening and questioning.
Apply fair summary in the context of listening and questioning.
Evaluate and justify decisions about consent-based questioning in the context of listening and questioning.

lessons.title: Reflective listening
lessons.outcome: Explain reflective listening in the context of listening and questioning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving reflective listening; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to listening simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain reflective listening from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of reflective listening; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Question types
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish question types in the context of listening and questioning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving question types; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to listening simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain question types from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of question types; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Fair summary
lessons.outcome: Apply fair summary in the context of listening and questioning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving fair summary; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to listening simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain fair summary from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of fair summary; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Consent-based questioning
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about consent-based questioning in the context of listening and questioning.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving consent-based questioning; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to listening simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain consent-based questioning from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of consent-based questioning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of reflective listening; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of question types; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of fair summary; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of consent-based questioning; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Communication instructor; language instructor as needed.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
